name: Letrozole
description: A reversible non-steroidal aromatase inhibitor approved for hormone-receptor-positive breast cancer, more potent at estrogen suppression than anastrozole.

systems.note: Inhibition of aromatase; the intended pharmacology.
Estrogen deprivation reduces bone mineral density; labelled.
Adverse lipid movement under estrogen deprivation is labelled.

monitors.why: The direct index of effect; the more potent inhibitor makes over-suppression easier to reach.
